Handmade with care, this ceramic mug is made to be part of your daily routine. Each piece is crafted by hand, so small variations make every mug one of a kind. It's a cozy choice for your morning coffee, an afternoon tea, or a thoughtful gift for someone who appreciates handmade goods.

Care is simple: this mug is dishwasher safe, so cleanup is easy. Please note that it is not microwave safe, so heat your drink another way before pouring it in.
